mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(t.total_amount), 0) FROM orders t WHERE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders t WHERE
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t.customer_id) FROM orders t WHERE AND t.customer_id IS NOT NULL

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(t.pay_time, '%m-%d') AS label, COALESCE(SUM(t.total_amount), 0) AS value, COUNT(*) AS count FROM orders t WHERE
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(t.pay_time, '%m-%d'), DATE(t.pay_time) ORDER BY DATE(t.pay_time)

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(t.pay_time, '%Y-%m') AS label, COALESCE(SUM(t.total_amount), 0) AS value, COUNT(*) AS count FROM orders t WHERE
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(t.pay_time, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY label

SELECT t.create_by AS username, COALESCE(su.real_name, t.create_by_name, t.create_by) AS realName, COUNT(*) AS orderCount, COALESCE(SUM(t.total_amount), 0) AS orderAmount FROM orders t LEFT JOIN sys_user su ON su.username = t.create_by AND su.deleted = 0 WHERE AND t.create_by IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY t.create_by, realName ORDER BY orderAmount DESC
